subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this protected Signal PR require redacted live receive-path evidence before merge, or may focused regression coverage be accepted because a linked Signal account is unavailable?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly targeted and test-covered, but the required external-PR real-behavior proof is unavailable; accepting a test-only exception is a maintainer release-confidence decision.

options.title: Require live receive proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted after-fix Signal bridge transcript, log, or terminal capture demonstrates a debounced batch reaching the agent with real line breaks.

options.title: Accept focused proof exception
options.body: Explicitly waive live proof and merge based on the focused inbound-context regression coverage plus normal exact-head checks.

recommendation.title: Require live receive proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted after-fix Signal bridge transcript, log, or terminal capture demonstrates a debounced batch reaching the agent with real line breaks.
